title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Individual Monthly Rate Sheet
content:
# Individual monthly rates — Prepaid Dental HMO Plans

Monthly premium for the Cascade DentalCare DHMO plans at the individual rate, in US dollars per month, by coverage tier. Each figure is the USD per month individual rate for the coverage tier named in its column.

| Plan | Member only | Member and spouse | Member and children | Family |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 13.25 | 25.18 | 27.83 | 39.75 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 15.40 | 29.26 | 32.34 | 46.20 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 17.85 | 33.92 | 37.49 | 53.55 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 20.10 | 38.19 | 42.21 | 60.30 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 23.65 | 44.94 | 49.67 | 70.95 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 27.30 | 51.87 | 57.33 | 81.90 |

**Coverage tiers.** Member only; member and spouse; member and children; family.

**Reading the sheet.** The rate is selected by two things only: the plan and the coverage tier. Hypothetical example: a subscriber on the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 whose coverage tier is member and children is rated at 37.49 per month; were that coverage tier family, the rate would be 53.55 per month.
